summary: Iteration 6: tested Family Groups + per-attendee QR tickets + PDF + check-in, end to end (backend and UI). Backend: new pytest suite test_phase6_family_tickets.py has 26/26 passing, and the Phase 5 regression suite has 17/17 passing. UI flows checked with Playwright: member My Family add/edit/delete with status badges; admin Family Approvals tabs plus verify/reject with a note (the note shows on the member dashboard); Diwali Mela purchase in named mode (self $20, Anya child $10, Baby under-3 $0, guest $20, total $50; pending family member shows as a disabled chip); anonymous quantity mode (tickets named '<buyer> – Guest N'); success modal ticket list and a valid PDF download; My Tickets list and PDF; admin check-in showing Welcome in! / Already checked in / Invalid ticket / different-event error, with the counter going 1/11 to 2/11; the camera button starts the scanner without crashing; admin Ticket Orders shows 'x/y checked in' and a PDF download; the Child 3-11 price field saves. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Missing required field (e.g. slug) raises a pydantic ValidationError inside the handler and returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 422/400 (pre-existing).

Age band is computed at event.start_date, falling back to NOW when start_date is null (evt-2 has start_date=None, only the free-text date 'November 1, 2026'). The frontend AttendeePicker uses event.start_date too, so the two agree. But a kid who turns 3 or 12 between purchase and the event gets the wrong band. Consider parsing the legacy 'date' string or requiring start_date for ticketed events.

total only counts orders that have a tickets[] array. Legacy orders created before this feature have no tickets, so they are left out of the check-in denominator and cannot be checked in. Consider a backfill migration that generates tickets for old orders.
Deleting an event leaves orphan ticket_orders. They still show in the member 'My Tickets' list and in admin Ticket Orders (seen with TEST_phase5_event leftovers from the Phase 5 test suite).
Tickets on orders with payment_status=pending can be checked in. The UI shows a 'Payment pending — collect at door' warning, so this may be intended; confirm the business rule.
Read-modify-write of the whole ticket_types array: concurrent purchases can lose increments or overwrite admin edits. Use $inc with arrayFilters (pre-existing).

issues: Says 'Confirmation sent to <email>' but emails are mocked or not sent, which is misleading.
A wrong-event ticket shows the title 'Invalid ticket'. A distinct title such as 'Wrong event' would be clearer for door staff (the detail text is correct).
Editing only the relation still shows the toast 'An admin will verify them shortly', but the status correctly stays Verified.
Row Edit/Delete buttons and the modal Save button have no data-testid (the tests used title='Edit').

action_items: Optional: return 422 instead of 500 on generic admin CRUD validation errors
Optional: use the event date for the age band when start_date is null; backfill tickets[] for legacy orders
Optional: delete or flag orphan ticket orders when an event is deleted
Optional: add data-testid to CrudPage edit/delete/save buttons
Optional: reword the 'Confirmation sent' copy while emails are mocked
critical_code_review_comments: family_tickets.py: clean and well scoped. _id is stripped, ownership is enforced on family CRUD, and the PDF endpoint requires an owner token or a matching buyer email (order_id + email is a weak secret but acceptable).
server.py purchase_tickets is long (~180 lines); consider extracting attendee resolution and pricing into helpers.
TicketPurchaseModal.jsx is 574 lines; consider splitting the success view and the quantity picker into components.
quantity_sold should use atomic $inc to avoid race conditions.
seed_data_creation: Test data was created and then cleaned up: temporary events, TEST_ family members, TEST orders. Also deleted the leftover TEST_phase5_event orphan orders. evt-2 quantity_sold is back to 5. Demo family Anya Demo and Baby Demo were left untouched (approved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_phase6_family_tickets.py -v (self-cleaning). The ticketed event list page is /events/upcoming (buy-tickets-diwali-mela-2026), not /events. The purchase payload requires event_id in the body. The admin event create payload requires slug. The system date in this environment is about Oct 2026. Check-in camera works with Chromium's fake device in headless mode.
